# Network Operations Platform: KPI monitoring with live Power BI

A web platform for managing a mobile network's sites, KPIs, tickets and field
interventions, with a Power BI report that updates live as KPIs are logged.

Built during my IT internship at Tunisie Telecom (Jul–Aug 2025), then extended
(Nov 2026) with PostgreSQL and a live DirectQuery Power BI layer.
**All data in this repository is fictional** (generated by `seed_data.py`).

## What it does

| Profile | Can do |
|---|---|
| Administrator / Engineer | Manage sites and site-code pools, log daily KPIs, open tickets, rate interventions, view dashboards |
| Technician | See assigned tickets, log interventions |
| Manager | View intervention dashboards |

- **KPIs tracked per site per day:** call blocking rate, call drop rate, availability,
  voice traffic (Erlang), data traffic (GB), VoLTE traffic (GB).
- **In-app dashboards** (Chart.js): QoS trends, worst-offender sites, zero-traffic sites,
  supplier benchmark, traffic vs. blocking, ticket statistics.
- **Security:** hashed passwords, role-based access, optional email activation and
  email two-factor authentication (`ENABLE_EMAIL_2FA=true`).
- **Live BI:** a star schema exposed as PostgreSQL views (`sql/bi_views.sql`), read by
  Power BI in DirectQuery with automatic page refresh.

## Architecture

```
Flask app ──writes──► PostgreSQL (Docker)
                          │  operational tables: users, site, kpi_stats, tickets, interventions…
                          │
                          └─ schema bi (views, read-only role powerbi_reader)
                               dim_date · dim_site · dim_user · fact_kpi_daily · fact_ticket
                                              │
                                              ▼
                               Power BI Desktop (DirectQuery, auto page refresh)
```

## Run it

Requirements: Python 3.11+, Docker Desktop, Power BI Desktop (for the report).

```powershell
copy .env.example .env               # then edit the passwords
docker compose up -d                 # PostgreSQL on localhost:5432
python -m venv venv
venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
venv\Scripts\python init_db.py       # schema + BI views + read-only Power BI role
venv\Scripts\python seed_data.py     # 34 sites, 180 days of KPIs, ~110 tickets
venv\Scripts\python app.py           # http://127.0.0.1:5000
```

Demo logins: `eng1`, `tech1`, `admin`, `manager`, with the password set in `DEMO_PASSWORD`.

Power BI: follow [powerbi/BUILD_GUIDE.md](powerbi/BUILD_GUIDE.md). To watch it update live:

```powershell
venv\Scripts\python simulate_live_kpis.py 2
```

## Tech stack

Python · Flask · PostgreSQL · psycopg · Docker Compose · SQL (views, star schema) ·
Power BI (DirectQuery, DAX) · HTML · Tailwind CSS · Alpine.js · Chart.js
